findings.observed_behavior: The test only checks that some PlanningError is raised, not that it is the 'task contract file was not found' error.
findings.reproducible_evidence: The test uses `with self.assertRaises(PlanningError):` and never checks the message. Any other PlanningError would also pass it.
findings.required_behavior: Optionally, assert the message too, e.g. assertRaisesRegex(PlanningError, 'task contract file was not found').
findings.required_outcome: The test pins the specific error that the acceptance criterion names.
findings.violated_criterion: Acceptance: the existing PlanningError (task contract file was not found) is raised

findings.observed_behavior: Runtime worktree trees are still listed in full, though their files are never read.
findings.reproducible_evidence: `sorted((self.root / "agent-system").glob("**/*.json"))` still lists and sorts every JSON file under agent-system/runtime/ before the prefix filter skips them.
findings.required_behavior: Optionally, prune agent-system/runtime while walking the tree (e.g. os.walk or Path.walk with pruning), so large worktree copies are never listed.
findings.required_outcome: Discovery cost doesn't grow with the number of runtime attempts and worktrees.
